title: Workspace ONE to Intune Application Rebuild & Repackaging
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (rebuild/repackage an app estate from a legacy MDM into Intune across Win32/store/mobile; detection/assignment parity, validation, higher volume/risk).
Adjacent to intune-win32-app-packaging-deployment (net-new Win32 packaging); THIS is the rebuild-from-Workspace-ONE, multi-platform migration angle.
hook: Rebuild every app from Workspace ONE in Intune — and prove each one still deploys
problem: Apps are where Workspace ONE migrations bog down: every Win32, store, and mobile app has to be rebuilt in Intune with correct detection, requirements, assignments, and configuration — and validated so nobody loses the software they work in. Done by hand it's slow and error-prone. This solution gives you a repeatable way to rebuild and repackage the Workspace ONE application estate into Intune: inventory the source apps, rebuild them with correct logic, migrate deployment/assignment workflows, and validate each one before cutover.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the app-migration model, mapping Workspace ONE app types to Intune (Win32 .intunewin, store apps, managed mobile apps), detection/requirement/assignment parity, app configuration, and the validation gate.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Workspace ONE app export/inventory, packaging tooling, per-platform app channels, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory source apps, prioritize and rebuild each in Intune with correct detection/requirements, recreate assignment workflows, handle app configuration, validate deployment, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — source-vs-target app inventory discovery, app install/detection validation, a rebuild coverage and deployment-success report, safe remediation of failed app installs, and an app-assignment group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to rebuild and repackage the Workspace ONE application estate into Intune — inventory source apps, rebuild with correct detection and assignments, migrate deployment workflows, and validate each one before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
